CATL had direct battery exposure, strong cash conversion and a visible 2021-22 profit path, but the stock had also rerated strongly and trailing earnings growth was still modest.

changeHypothesis.summary: NEV monthly sales more than doubled and the long-term policy framework became clearer, but BYD/CATL had already rerated sharply. The opportunity is structurally real; the unresolved question is whether future growth exceeds an already-premium baseline.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: The 2021-2035 plan and record monthly sales make the demand shift structural.
disconfirmingEvidence: BYD forward PE in the Nov27 strategy was ~92x 2021E and ~73x 2022E.
CATL 9M profit was still slightly down YoY.
